description: The FULL 24/7 crypto day-state board: all 81 Robinhood-tradable coins with trend distances (20/50/200-day), multi-timeframe tape lights, ATR%, relative strength vs BTC, room to the 20-day high, volume z-score, mechanical UP/CHOP/DOWN state and cross-sectional ranks, plus the daily BTC/ETH gate and breadth. Publishes about every 5 minutes around the clock when the market moved. A state map, not a ranking. Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_crypto_day_live
